test_gtn_graph_equality: test two gtn Graph objects for structural equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes arcs and weights
test_gtn_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn Graph objects for isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering but checking structure
test_gtn_loadtxt: test loading a gtn Graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt and verify equality with the original
test_gtn_savetxt: test saving a gtn Graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt and verify the output format
test_gtn_save_load: test saving and loading a gtn Graph using gtn.save and gtn.load and verify roundtrip equality
